decisions.decision: A good's production-share coverage is derived dynamically (EXISTS against province_good_production's real contents), never a hardcoded list of the 52 covered goods
decisions.why: self-describing from what the save actually contains; a hardcoded list would silently go stale if a future save version changes coverage
decisions.rejected: a committed TS Set<string> of the 52 keys, this app's categories.ts precedent -- rejected because that precedent is for static game-definition data, not a save-data fact

decisions.decision: province_good_production.province_idx is INTEGER, matching provinces.idx's existing type, not BIGINT
decisions.why: province indices already fit INTEGER everywhere else in this schema, no evidence of a larger index space

decisions.decision: Unattributed production (no real-country owner) computed client-side by reusing loadLeaderboardCountries's existing country_type='Real' filter, mirroring LeaderboardTab.tsx's join-and-bucket-the-rest pattern exactly
decisions.why: reuses a proven pattern and an existing query instead of writing new SQL join/filter logic
decisions.rejected: a single SQL query joining nations and filtering country_type='Real' server-side

decisions.decision: Reuse LeaderboardTreemap.tsx for this feature's treemap, renamed to ShareTreemap.tsx (mechanical rename, no behavior change)
decisions.why: the component was already fully generic (title + entries, no Leaderboard-specific logic); now used by two unrelated features, the old name would actively mislead a future reader
decisions.rejected: leaving the name as-is and importing it cross-feature; writing a near-duplicate GoodProductionTreemap.tsx

decisions.decision: World Goods becomes a switchable page inside MarketsTab via an activeView state + VIEWS button group, mirroring LeaderboardTab.tsx's exact pattern -- not a new top-level Factbook nav entry
decisions.why: matches the user's own framing ("its own page under the Markets tab") and reuses an established in-app pattern rather than inventing a new navigation idiom
decisions.rejected: a new top-level Factbook nav entry alongside Wars/Leaderboard/Markets

decisions.decision: has_production_coverage is one column added directly to listWorldGoodsArrow's existing SQL, not a second query
decisions.why: one round trip, one source of truth for both the grid's coverage marker and the page's covered-vs-not gating logic
decisions.rejected: a separate listGoodsWithProductionCoverageArrow query decoded into a client-side Set

decisions.decision: WorldGoodsOverview's onSelectGood carries the clicked row's has_production_coverage directly (onSelectGood(good, hasProductionCoverage)), rather than WorldGoodsPage doing a separate decodeWorldGoods fetch+lookup
decisions.why: the grid already has this value in the click payload as a real column; avoids a second query, an extra piece of state, and a real async race (selecting a good before a separate list finishes loading) that the original contract would have had
decisions.rejected: WorldGoodsPage loading and holding its own decodeWorldGoods list to look up coverage by good name, as originally planned in contracts/ui-components.md

decisions.decision: Post-ship follow-up: moved the World Goods/Markets view switch from a MarketsTab-local top-of-content button group into the shell side nav (MarketsSideNav.tsx), mirroring LeaderboardSideNav exactly
decisions.why: user feedback after ship: this project reserves the side nav for primary page switches (as Leaderboard/Countries already do), keeping MarketsTab-local toggles for a secondary axis only
decisions.rejected: leaving the switch as a top-of-content button group, consistent with the initial ship but inconsistent with the rest of the app
